title: Any Stone Recipe
description: Allows for any kind of stone to be used in crafting recipes of tools and some special blocks.
body:
#### About
This datapack allows for any stone-like material to be used in a crafting recipe that normaly require cobblestone.

Materials it applies to:
- andesite
- cobblestone
- diorite
- granite
- mossy cobblestone
- stone

Recipies it applies to:
- dispenser
- dropper
- furnace
- lever
- observer
- piston
- smithing table
- stone axe
- stone hoe
- stone pickaxe
- stone shovel
- stone sword

#### Datapack Version
The current datapack version is complete, but I am currently working on applying it to different versions of the game.

#### Game Version
The datapack is currently available for:
- 1.13.x
- 1.14.x
